title: Global sections of a resolution of the direct image of injectives is a quasi-isomorphism
statement: Let $h:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $\mathcal I^\bullet$ be a cochain complex of injective $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-sp-injective-resolutions], [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] with $\mathcal I^n=0$ for $n<0$, and $h_*\mathcal I^\bullet$ the complex of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules obtained by applying the direct image $h_*$ [def-pc-module-pullback] termwise, $(h_*\mathcal I^n)(V)=\mathcal I^n(h^{-1}V)$. Let $\mathcal J'^\bullet$ be a cochain complex of injective $\mathcal O_Y$-modules with $\mathcal J'^n=0$ for $n<0$ and $\lambda:h_*\mathcal I^\bullet\to\mathcal J'^\bullet$ a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules]. Then $\Gamma(Y,\lambda):\Gamma(Y,h_*\mathcal I^\bullet)=\Gamma(X,\mathcal I^\bullet)\to\Gamma(Y,\mathcal J'^\bullet)$ is a quasi-isomorphism of complexes of abelian groups (indeed of $\mathcal O_Y(Y)$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]): $H^p(\Gamma(Y,\lambda))$ is bijective for every $p$.

source.place: Cohomology of Sheaves, Remark 01FB (remark-explain-arrow: 'The vertical arrow is a quasi-isomorphism by Lemma 01EZ'), Lemma 01EZ (lemma-before-Leray) with Remark 01F0 (remark-elucidate-lemma), Lemma 01EX (lemma-pushforward-injective: $h_*\mathcal I$ is right acyclic for $\Gamma(V,-)$); literature/stacks-project/derived.tex Lemma 015E (lemma-leray-acyclicity)
